city.Moroni.description: The chief industry of the Comoros is perfume, made from plants grown on the islands.
city.Moroni.flag: yellow, white, red and blue bands with a green triangle holding a crescent and four stars
city.Moscow.description: The Soviet Union is the largest country in the world. It occupies one-sixth of the earth's land area.
city.Moscow.greeting: In Russian, a friendly hi is “Privet” (pree-VYET).
city.Moscow.flag: three bands of white, blue and red
city.New Delhi.description: New Delhi, with a metropolitan population of more than 30 million, is the capital of India, a nation of over 1.4 billion people.
city.New Delhi.flag: saffron, white and green bands with a navy spoked wheel
city.New York.description: The headquarters of the United Nations, located in New York, adds to the multi-cultural nature of the city.
city.New York.greeting: In the US, a casual hi is “Hey there” (hay thair).
city.New York.flag: fifty white stars on blue with thirteen red-and-white stripes
city.Oslo.description: Oslo, the capital and largest city in Norway, is a major industrial and maritime center as well as the seat of government.
city.Oslo.greeting: In Norwegian, a friendly hi is “Hei” (hay).
city.Paris.description: Paris, the capital of France, is a center of art and culture, and home of the world famous Eiffel Tower.
city.Paris.flag: three bands of blue, white and red
city.Peking.description: Peking is the capital of the People's Republic of China. One of this nation's most famous landmarks is the Great Wall.
city.Peking.greeting: In Mandarin, hello is “Nǐ hǎo” (nee how).
city.Peking.flag: red with one large yellow star and four smaller stars
city.Port Moresby.description: Port Moresby is the capital of Papua New Guinea, a land of jungles and volcanic mountains.
city.Port Moresby.landmark: the highlands just north of Australia
